problem_text:
A municipality aims to devise a strategy to curtail nutrient runoff from several agricultural fields into a nearby watershed. Initially, no mitigation practices have been implemented.

The characteristics of each field are as follows:
* For Field 1, runoff coefficient is 1.139, cultivated area is 145.063.
* For Field 2, runoff coefficient is 1.837, cultivated area is 186.821.
* For Field 3, runoff coefficient is 0.621, cultivated area is 168.599.
* For Field 4, runoff coefficient is 2.987, cultivated area is 88.282.
* For Field 5, runoff coefficient is 2.155, cultivated area is 223.798.
* For Field 6, runoff coefficient is 2.134, cultivated area is 207.578.
* For Field 7, runoff coefficient is 0.549, cultivated area is 125.279.
* For Field 8, runoff coefficient is 2.224, cultivated area is 215.416.
* For Field 9, runoff coefficient is 1.542, cultivated area is 215.621.

To mitigate nutrient loss, several conservation practices are available, each characterized by a specific reduction efficacy:
* By implementing Practice1, nutrient loss will be reduced by 68%
* By implementing Practice2, nutrient loss will be reduced by 42%
* By implementing Practice3, nutrient loss will be reduced by 79%
* By implementing Practice4, nutrient loss will be reduced by 24%
* By implementing Practice5, nutrient loss will be reduced by 82%
* By implementing Practice6, nutrient loss will be reduced by 32%
* By implementing Practice7, nutrient loss will be reduced by 81%
* By implementing Practice8, nutrient loss will be reduced by 81%
* By implementing Practice9, nutrient loss will be reduced by 82%

Adopting a practice on a field incurs an additional cost per unit of cultivated area. The cost structure for all field–practice combinations is summarized below:
| Field \ Practice | Practice1 | Practice2 | Practice3 | Practice4 | Practice5 | Practice6 | Practice7 | Practice8 | Practice9 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Field 1 | 47.743 | 47.952 | 59.969 | 109.398 | 48.318 | 143.653 | 66.117 | 17.487 | 104.307 |
| Field 2 | 49.462 | 187.294 | 72.815 | 10.52 | 137.61 | 182.307 | 168.694 | 137.114 | 38.337 |
| Field 3 | 27.116 | 107.224 | 147.477 | 29.245 | 58.619 | 53.92 | 197.847 | 66.244 | 98.213 |
| Field 4 | 28.964 | 43.193 | 17.494 | 65.208 | 162.303 | 69.414 | 150.323 | 28.05 | 154.059 |
| Field 5 | 18.719 | 171.88 | 136.037 | 42.397 | 77.93 | 93.166 | 128.143 | 176.91 | 27.661 |
| Field 6 | 164.843 | 44.745 | 86.148 | 192.839 | 61.648 | 83.286 | 171.628 | 161.981 | 133.281 |
| Field 7 | 161.413 | 31.481 | 142.272 | 21.143 | 189.069 | 40.285 | 89.045 | 122.243 | 162.43 |
| Field 8 | 138.895 | 44.44 | 82.153 | 78.134 | 15.475 | 140.048 | 169.322 | 194.954 | 34.825 |
| Field 9 | 184.876 | 31.458 | 88.144 | 18.735 | 59.706 | 69.705 | 143.868 | 138.806 | 155.83 |

Please determine how to assign conservation practices to each field (fields may adopt multiple practices concurrently), and note that a field may also remain partially untreated if necessary. The objective is to ensure that the total nutrient runoff is reduced by at least a proportion P = 0.488 of the baseline amount, while minimizing the total implementation cost.
